clues.text: Deborah told him the LORD had gone before him, so he led his men down Mount Tabor against Sisera.
Called to fight Sisera, he said he would go only if Deborah the prophetess went with him.
Deborah warned this commander the honor would not be his, because the LORD would hand Sisera to a woman.
He chased Sisera's chariots and army to Harosheth-hagoyim, and not a single enemy soldier was left.
Arriving in pursuit of Sisera, he was led into Jael's tent and found the enemy commander dead.
Speaking to Israel, Samuel said the LORD sent him, along with Jerubbaal and Jephthah, to rescue them from enemies.
In a list of the heroes of faith, he is named right after Gideon and just before Samson.

taken: At Mount Tabor she told Barak to arise, for the LORD had delivered Sisera into his hand that day.
